pathAssistantSteps.info: Application cancelled; the lost booklet remains blacklisted.
Verify the FIR, Annexure F, address proof and any damaged booklet remnants surrendered at the counter.
Lost / Damaged draft. Police FIR for the lost booklet and a signed Annexure F are BOTH mandatory before submission.
Grant only after the Pre-PV report is Cleared and every Risk Flag is closed.
Fee and penalty received. Proceed to document verification.
Lost / Damaged re-issue carries a penalty fee in addition to the base fee.
Lost / Damaged is Pre-PV ONLY. Police clearance must be received before granting - never grant on a pending PV.
Replacement booklet queued. Ensure the lost booklet is blacklisted before printing.
Rejected - typically adverse police verification or a missing FIR.
Submitted. Confirm the original FIR copy and Annexure F are attached and the old passport is marked Lost on the Passport record.
